verses.1: If the thief is caught in the act and killed, he will die without having been able to shed any blood.
verses.2: If the sun rises over him, then he will be compensated. But if he has no money, then he will be sold as a slave.
verses.3: If he finds the stolen goods, he will be punished for two years.
verses.4: For if a man plows a field or a vineyard, and then moves to another city or village, he will be better off than if he had stayed in his own field and vineyard.
verses.5: For if fire comes out, and it finds thorns or thorns that can be eaten, then it will be destroyed. Or if it comes upon a field full of thorns, then it will also be destroyed. The flames will destroy everything in their path.
verses.6: If a man gives his neighbor gold or goods to keep, and then the thief steals those items from the man’s house, if the thief is caught, he must pay back double.
verses.7: If the thief cannot be found, and if he does not go before the householder to plead with God, then he will surely be punished by God.
verses.8: For all sins committed against others, against their property, against their honor, and for all losses that occur as a result of such actions. For those who say, “This is an act against God.” Then God will forgive both of them. God will reward them both for their actions.
verses.9: For when a man gives his neighbor a sheep or a lamb, and all the animals are kept under his care, if he dies or is taken away from him, no one sees it.
verses.10: Thirty will be between them, if he does not extend his hand to destroy his enemy and take him as his own.
verses.11: And if a thief steals from his owner, he must pay back to his owner.
verses.12: If it is a true attack, then it will be witnessed by those who were involved in the attack. They will not be spared.
verses.13: And if a man asks his enemy to give him back what he stole from him, and he is killed by his own husband, then there is no one who can compensate for it.
verses.14: If he doesn’t pay with money, then he must pay in kind. If he is a tenant, then he must pay his rent.
verses.15: And it would be wonderful if a man could find a woman who isn’t married, and sleep with her quickly.
verses.16: If her father wants to give her gold, he should do so quickly, like the wind.
verses.17: What cannot be broken will not survive.
verses.18: Everything that lies with animals will also die.
verses.19: The offering to God will be rejected, not for Jehovah alone.
verses.20: And you shall not enslave them, nor force them to work, just as you were slaves in Egypt.
verses.21: All fools and foolishness shall not be obeyed.
verses.22: If you refuse to answer him, then he will cry out to me. I will hear his cries.
verses.23: And I struck you with a plague, and I killed you in the wilderness. Now you will be cursed, and your children will also be cursed.
verses.24: If you treat my people like this, treating the poor with you in such a manner, then they will not be able to live in peace. They will not be able to rest peacefully at all.
verses.25: If you offer sacrifices for the peace of your enemy, then before the sun rises, we will return him to him.
verses.26: For he is like a covering for her; his cloak is like a bed on which she can lie. He will cry out to me, and I will hear him, just as if I were listening to a voice from afar.
verses.27: God will not forgive you. Do not be cruel to your people. Do not harm them.
verses.28: Your fill and your comfort shall not be elsewhere but in your children. Give them to me.
verses.29: So, do this for your servant. For seven days, he shall be with his mother on the eighth day. Then you shall give him to me.
verses.30: And the people of God shall be my sheep. They shall not be eaten by wild animals in the field. You shall throw them away as trash.
